contract: Store-only PostgreSQL translation using a consumer-owned Ecto Repo and optional prefix: atomic append CAS, immutable records/checkpoints, outbox ack and bounded retention. Migration helper only; no shipped Repo/config/Application.
limits: Subset only: no general SQL API, CDC, SQLite, migration framework, database-per-service, replication or disk/fsync guarantee.
Atomic append capability; torn-tail repair always rejected as torn_repair_unsupported.
PostgreSQL transaction/locking/storage behavior is upstream; finite local tests do not establish universal durability or exactly-once effects.
Consumers own the Repo, schema deployment, access control, fsync/synchronous_commit, backups and operational recovery.

grounding.claim: K1–K11 plus D11/D15/D17/D19 on a disposable PostgreSQL database: restart, late commits, backend termination, unavailable service, corruption, FK and lock ordering. Missing/unreachable URL fails closed.
Local step-4 test observation: PostgreSQL 14.24, fsync=on, synchronous_commit=on. Test prints actual settings; not a production or all-execution claim.
Ecto SQL 3.14.0 transaction, SQL and consumer Repo integration are upstream contracts.
Postgrex 0.22.4 protocol, connection and error behavior are upstream contracts.
PostgreSQL transaction atomicity, uniqueness, row locking, WAL/fsync and crash semantics are upstream server contracts reached through Postgrex, not local proofs.
Elixir validation, exceptions and BEAM execution are upstream contracts, not proved here.
OTP 29.1.2 GenServer, process lifecycle and crypto APIs are upstream contracts; no disk durability or exactly-once guarantee.

The consumer configures an appropriate PostgreSQL service (including fsync/synchronous_commit), schema permissions and maintenance; tests exercise named local scenarios, not the consumer's production deployment.

telemetry.contract: Consumer Ecto Repo emits upstream events; Elzoo adds no telemetry events.

config.contract: Consumer Repo module and optional SQL prefix; no global Repo/config shipped.

control.contract: Consumer owns Repo lifecycle; no separate Elzoo database control process.
